instruction: Enable only Ed25519 and ED25519-SK host keys for SSH

instruction: Whitelist specific users for SSH access with AllowUsers
output: echo 'AllowUsers alice bob charlie' | sudo tee -a /etc/ssh/sshd_config && sudo systemctl restart sshd

instruction: Set a custom AuthorizedKeysFile pointing to a centralized location
output: echo 'AuthorizedKeysFile /etc/ssh/authorized_keys/%u' | sudo tee -a /etc/ssh/sshd_config && sudo mkdir -p /etc/ssh/authorized_keys && sudo systemctl restart sshd

instruction: Use a Match block to apply different settings for users from a specific address
output:
cat | sudo tee -a /etc/ssh/sshd_config << 'EOF'
Match Address 10.0.0.0/8
  PasswordAuthentication yes
  AllowUsers backup-robot
EOF
sudo systemctl restart sshd

instruction: Chroot a SFTP-only user to their home directory
output:
sudo useradd -m -s /usr/sbin/nologin sftp-user && sudo mkdir -p /home/sftp-user/uploads && sudo chown root:root /home/sftp-user && sudo chmod 755 /home/sftp-user && cat | sudo tee -a /etc/ssh/sshd_config << 'EOF'
Match User sftp-user
  ChrootDirectory /home/sftp-user
  ForceCommand internal-sftp
  X11Forwarding no
  AllowTcpForwarding no
  PermitTTY no
EOF
sudo systemctl restart sshd

instruction: ForceCommand to run a script when a specific user logs in
output:
cat | sudo tee -a /etc/ssh/sshd_config << 'EOF'
Match User monitor
  ForceCommand /usr/local/bin/run-monitor.sh
  PermitTTY yes
  X11Forwarding no
EOF
sudo systemctl restart sshd
